fullPassage:
I wake up to the sound of cheerful music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room.
"Good morning, Sumin. It's time to get up!"
"Hi, Luna!" I say to my AI friend.
I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror.
"How's the weather?"
"It's sunny today."
"Great. I can play soccer during lunch break."
"Good! You'll have fun with your friends!"
I enjoy a healthy breakfast with my family and walk to school.
In history class, Ms. Shin guides us on a virtual trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a grand pyramid.
"Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of ancient Egypt. You can see their lives in these wall paintings. The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death."
Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!
After lunch, I go outside to play soccer. I feel happy when my team wins!
"Sumin! That was a great goal!"
"Thanks, Minji. We did well together!"
We both smile and cheer for each other.
Nice work! You reached 70% of your exercise goal!
At home, I review my studies with Luna.
"I couldn't solve these three questions on the math test today. Can you explain them?"
"OK. I'll give you some tips and problems to practice."
"Thanks. I feel that I'm ready for the next test. By the way, I learned about Pharaohs and pyramids in history class. Can you recommend some video clips to watch? I want to learn more about Egyptian history."
"Sure. Here they are."
During dinner, I talk about my day with my family.
"How was your day?"
"It was fun. I think that my soccer skills are getting better."
After that, I take a walk with my dad.
I keep a diary before bed and go to sleep.
"Good night, Luna. Please play a hip-hop song at 7 a.m. tomorrow."
"OK. Sweet dreams!"

I wake up to the sound of (A)__________ music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room. I brush my teeth and check today's (B)__________ on the smart mirror. I enjoy a (C)__________ breakfast with my family and walk to school. I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror. "How's the weather?"
"It's sunny today."
"Great.
questions.stem: 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 기분 좋은 음악 (B) 일정 (C) 건강한 아침 식사
det.analysis:
✅ ① cheerful — schedule — healthy: 원문 그대로
❌ ② cheerful — weather — healthy: (B) weather는 아침에 물어보는 내용이지 거울에서 확인하는 것이 아님
❌ ③ wonderful — schedule — grand: wonderful은 수업 감상, grand는 피라미드 수식어
❌ ④ sunny — mirror — cheerful: sunny는 날씨, mirror는 기구 이름
det.tip: cheerful(기분 좋은), schedule(일정), healthy(건강한) — 아침 루틴 핵심 단어

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 두 goal의 의미를 바르게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 첫 번째 goal = 골(축구 득점), 두 번째 goal = 목표(운동 목표)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 골(득점) — 목표: 축구에서의 골 vs 운동 목표
❌ ① 목표 — 목표: 첫 번째는 축구 골
❌ ② 골(득점) — 골(득점): 두 번째는 운동 목표
❌ ④ 규칙 — 목표: goal에 '규칙'이란 뜻 없음
det.tip: goal: ① (스포츠) 골, 득점 ② 목표

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a plan that lists events or activities and the times they will happen"

det.korean: 일정, 스케줄 — 이벤트나 활동의 시간을 나열한 계획
det.analysis:
✅ ④ schedule: 활동과 시간을 나열한 계획 → 일정
❌ ① diary: 일기 — 하루 기록
❌ ② mirror: 거울 — 사물
❌ ③ breakfast: 아침 식사 — 음식
det.tip: schedule = a plan listing events and times(일정)

questions.passage: (__________) a new world in class is wonderful! After lunch, I go outside to play soccer. I feel happy when my team wins! We both smile and cheer for each other.
questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸시오.

"(Explore) a new world in class is wonderful!" (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 동명사 주어: Exploring — 문장의 주어 자리에 동명사 사용
det.analysis: Explore → Exploring: 문장의 주어 역할을 하므로 동명사(-ing) 형태가 적절. 'Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!'
det.tip: 동명사 주어: -ing 형태가 문장의 주어 역할

questions.passage: "Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of ancient Egypt. You can see their lives in these wall paintings. The ancient Egyptians (__________) in life after death."
questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸시오.

"The ancient Egyptians (believe) in life after death." (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 과거시제: believed — 고대 이집트인들의 과거 사실이므로 과거형
det.analysis: believe → believed: 고대 이집트인의 신앙을 설명하므로 과거시제(-ed) 사용. 'The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death.'

questions.passage:
I wake up to the sound of cheerful music. The curtains open, and sunlight fills my room.
"Good morning, Sumin. It's time to get up!"
"Hi, Luna!" I say to my AI friend.
I brush my teeth and check today's schedule on the smart mirror.
"How's the weather?"
"It's sunny today."
"Great. I can play soccer during lunch break."
"Good! You'll have fun with your ____!"
I enjoy a healthy breakfast with my family and walk to school.
In history class, Ms. Shin guides us on a virtual trip to Egypt. With our goggles on, we soon walk along the Nile River and enter a grand pyramid.
"Do you know about Pharaohs? They were the kings of ancient Egypt. You can see their lives in these wall paintings. The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death."
Exploring a new world in class is wonderful!
After lunch, I go outside to play soccer. I feel happy when my team wins!
"Sumin! That was a great goal!"
"Thanks, Minji. We did well together!"
We both smile and cheer for each other.
Nice work! You reached 70% of your exercise goal!
At home, I review my studies with Luna.
"I couldn't solve these three questions on the math test today. Can you explain them?"
"OK. I'll give you some tips and problems to practice."
"Thanks. I feel that I'm ready for the next test. By the way, I learned about Pharaohs and pyramids in history class. Can you recommend some video clips to watch? I want to learn more about Egyptian history."
"Sure. Here they are."
During dinner, I talk about my day with my family.
"How was your day?"
"It was fun. I think that my soccer skills are getting better."
After that, I take a walk with my dad.
I keep a diary before bed and go to sleep.
"Good night, Luna. Please play a hip-hop song at 7 a.m. tomorrow."
"OK. Sweet dreams!"
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ friends: 점심시간에 축구를 하면 '친구들'과 재미있게 놀 것 → 원문 일치
❌ ① teachers: 선생님과 축구는 문맥에 안 맞음
❌ ② parents: 부모님은 학교에 없음
❌ ④ books: 책과 재미있게 논다는 문맥 불일치
det.tip: have fun with friends(친구들과 재미있게 놀다)
